answer: Dispute bonds are a rental deposit. Newcomers lock 240 units for 15 epochs; anyone may challenge in 3 epochs. Nine jurors rule in 2 epochs. If fake, 80% is forfeited, 25% rewards the challenger, forger barred 12 epochs. A copper chest of 1,000 deposits locks 240,000 units; at 30% detection forfeit is 57,600, 14,400 to challengers. The opal rule applies: honest tenants recover 20 units per clean epoch; the vault of fakes pays its eviction.
